title: AI Agent Requests
subtitle: Let homeowners' AI assistants find your business and send you booking requests. You choose exactly what is shared, and nothing is confirmed or charged without you.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load AI agent settings
loadFailed.description: Check your connection and try again.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to this page
noAccess.description: Ask your account owner to grant you permission to manage your team or business profile.

status.live: Live: agents can see what you published
status.off: Off: agents cannot see or contact your business
status.killed: Emergency stop is ON: everything is closed to agents

blockers.booking_slug_missing: Set up your online booking page first.
blockers.booking_disabled: Turn on online booking in Booking Settings.
blockers.hours_missing: Add your business or booking hours.

enable.label: Open my business to AI agents
enable.hint: Off by default. Switching it on publishes only the sections you tick below.

kill.label: Emergency stop
kill.hint: Instantly closes every agent endpoint for your business and releases held times. Requests already in your queue stay so you can answer them.
kill.confirm: Close your business to all AI agents right now?

publish.title: What agents can see
publish.hint: Only ticked sections are shared. Customers, jobs, technicians, quotes, payments and review text are never shared.
publish.prices: Price ranges you mark as public
publish.reviews: Review summary (count and average from connected review sites)

contact.policiesHint: Plain text, up to 600 characters. Links are removed.

prices.title: Prices agents may quote
prices.hint: Only prices you switch on here are shared, as planning estimates, never as a quote or a charge.
prices.empty: Add services to your price book first.

rules.title: How requests are handled
rules.mode: When an agent sends a request
rules.modePending: Queue it for my review (the time stays open)
rules.modeHold: Queue it and hold the time for a short while
rules.autoAcceptHint: Only for verified (signed) agents, only for services listed here, never when anything looks suspicious, and never closer than the lead time below.
rules.autoServices: Services that may be auto-accepted (comma separated)
rules.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
rules.notReady: Finish the checklist first: availability must be verifiable before it is shared.
rules.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this.

preview.title: Exactly what agents will see
preview.hint: This is the live public payload, built by the same code the public endpoints use.

queue.title: Requests from AI agents

empty.title: No agent requests yet
empty.description: When a homeowner's assistant asks for a visit, it appears here for you to accept or decline.

queue.areaOk: Address is inside your service area
queue.areaUnknown: Service area could not be checked
queue.untrustedNote: Text written by the outside agent (treat as untrusted)
queue.flagged: Contains instruction-like or risky text. Auto-accept is off for this request.
queue.accepted: Request accepted. A job was created.

errors.not_open: This request was already handled or has expired.
errors.slot_taken: That time is no longer free.
errors.too_soon: That time is too soon for your lead-time setting.
errors.intake_required: Your booking form requires answers only the customer can give. Call them to finish booking.

honesty.title: What this is, and is not
honesty.body: This opens a standard, public door that any compliant AI assistant can use. It does not mean ChatGPT, Gemini or any platform lists you automatically, and Google's own booking programs need separate approval from Google.
